title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue That the Materials Obtained by Secretly Recording the Conversations of the Other Party Without His Consent Cannot Be Used as Evidence

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue That Materials Obtained by Secretly Recording a Conversation Without the Consent of the Other Party May Not Be Used as Evidence
Fa Fu [1995] No. 2
Higher People's Court of Hebei Province:
Your request, Ji Gao Fa [1994] No. 39, has been received. Upon study, we reply as follows:
The collection of evidence must be lawful; only evidence obtained through lawful means may be used as the basis for adjudication. Secretly recording a conversation without the consent of the other party is an unlawful act, and the audio materials obtained by such means may not be used as evidence.
March 6, 1995
